tools.description:
Browse the structured catalogs. Without dataset: list them (SP 800-53, 53A, 53B,
CSF, Privacy Framework, SP 800-171/172, SSDF, NICE, ...) with versions and the
publications that print them. With dataset: its top level (families, functions).
With parent_id: that item's children (controls of 'AC', subcategories of 'GV.OC').
tools.name: nist-csrc-mcp_nist_browse_catalogs

tools.description:
Get one catalog item: an SP 800-53 control ('AC-2', 'AC-2(1)'), an SP 800-53A
assessment procedure (dataset='SP 800-53A'), SP 800-53B baselines (dataset='SP
800-53B'), a CSF function, category or subcategory ('PR.AA-01'), an SP 800-171
requirement ('03.01.01'), and so on. Identifiers ignore case, zero padding and
punctuation. dataset takes a name ('SP 800-53', 'CSF 1.1', '800-53r4') or a CPRT id;
a name selects the current version, and without dataset the current publication is
used. Returns the text, parent and children, related items, cross-framework
mappings (filter with relation_framework, e.g. 'SP 800-53'), topic tags and the
page that prints it. include_structured adds parameters, statement parts and
baselines as JSON.
tools.name: nist-csrc-mcp_nist_get_catalog_item

tools.description:
Report corpus coverage: editions and pages archived, pages converted and how,
catalog data loaded, and the nightly refresh (`refresh`): when it last ran, the
editions it added or whose status changed, what it converted, and what failed.
tools.name: nist-csrc-mcp_nist_get_corpus_status

tools.description:
Get the original PDF of an edition to check a conversion against the source: a
temporary signed URL to the archived copy (fetch it directly, no authentication)
plus the official NIST URL and the file's SHA-256.
tools.name: nist-csrc-mcp_nist_get_pdf

tools.description:
Describe one publication edition: title, status, abstract, topics, versions and
links (supersedes, superseded by, drafts, parts), catalog datasets and PDF.

Pass edition_id, or query with a designation, DOI or URL ('SP 800-53', 'FIPS 203',
'SP 800-63B-4'). A query for a publication resolves to its current final edition;
name a revision or draft ('SP 800-53 Rev. 4', 'FIPS 140-3 IPD') to get that one.
Other matching editions are listed under resolution.
tools.name: nist-csrc-mcp_nist_get_publication

tools.description:
List CSRC topics (for example 'access control', 'cryptography', 'FISMA') with
counts of publications and catalog items. Use a topic name with nist_search.
tools.name: nist-csrc-mcp_nist_list_topics

tools.description:
Read 1-10 pages as Markdown: tables as Markdown or HTML, math in LaTeX. Start at
page_index (zero-based physical page) or at printed_page, the number printed on the
page ('24', 'vi'); each page's location gives both. Each page reports how it was
converted and lists the catalog items it prints; use nist_get_catalog_item for those.
representation='library_text' or 'both' returns the PDF's raw text layer;
start_char/end_char slice one page's raw text for exact quotation. Ranges stop at
40,000 characters (see next_page_index).
tools.name: nist-csrc-mcp_nist_read

tools.description:
Search NIST publications and catalogs. Start here.

Returns, in order:
- catalog_items: structured SP 800-53 controls, SP 800-53A procedures, CSF
  subcategories, SP 800-171 requirements and similar, from the newest release of
  each catalog. An exact identifier ('AC-2', 'PR.AA-01') includes the item's text.
  An item's assessment procedure and baseline entries (SP 800-53A/B, SP 800-171A)
  are listed under it in also_in. Prefer these to reading PDF pages.
- publications: matching publications with status (current, superseded, withdrawn,
  draft), ranked by their metadata, their best-matching pages and the catalog items
  they print; each lists that evidence (pages, items).
- passages: page excerpts to read with nist_read.

Keep kind='all' (the default) unless you need only one group: requirements,
controls and practices are best answered by catalog items, alongside the
publications that state them. A narrower search still lists the top matching items
under catalog_items_also_matching.

Catalog items and passages match by meaning as well as by words, so a question or
description works as a query; exact identifiers still rank first.

versions='current' (default) covers the current final edition of each publication.
'drafts' covers drafts; 'all' adds superseded and withdrawn editions. A query that
names a revision or draft includes all versions automatically.
kind limits results to one group. topic filters by CSRC topic (see
nist_list_topics). dataset limits catalog items to one catalog ('SP 800-53', 'CSF').
tools.name: nist-csrc-mcp_nist_search
